Rights holder for art: unknown from the files.

inspiration: Fog that walks with the player: the fog shader adds a walk-offset uniform and a time drift to its noise sampling (modules/game_shaders/shaders/fragment/fog.frag line 5). Recreate: a layered fog that moves against the camera with the player's walk, not only on a clock.

A library of named full-screen filters (fog, rain, snow, outline, sepia, grayscale, radial blur, an old-TV look, party colours) kept as small separate shaders and toggled in settings (modules/game_shaders/shaders/fragment/). Recreate: three or four of our own filters for hit flash, finisher blur, low-health grey and death.
Gold text with a shadow as a named text shader (modules/game_shaders/shaders/fragment/text_golden_shadow_bold_fragment.frag). Recreate: a gold label tier for rare loot names with its own shadow pass.
Status icons round a health ring (modules/game_healthcircle/images/conditions/, 49 PNG). Recreate: status glyphs on a ring around the portrait, readable at 375 px.

Death as one window: the death display takes a death type and a penalty and shows one window with a clear action (modules/game_playerdeath/playerdeath.lua line 41; deathwindow.otui line 3). Recreate: a death card that states the loss in one line and offers one respawn action.
Effects attached to an outfit through a per-outfit config file (modules/game_attachedeffects/configs/). Recreate: a per-armour-set effect entry in data, not in code.
Task cards tiered by backdrop (modules/game_taskboard/assets/images: normal, silver, gold task backdrops). Recreate: progression cards whose backdrop shows the tier at a glance.

briefs.label: Radial build wheel (category only)
briefs.why: Builds laid out as slices on one wheel let a player switch a whole set in one glance. The donor's module is under a proprietary EULA, so only the idea is taken.
briefs.keep: a radial layout with named presets and one slice per build piece
briefs.change: ours is a three-ring grid for a 375 px phone, with a preset tab bar and no donor art or code
briefs.ref: modules/game_wheel/wheel.otmod line 3 (title only); its code and art not read or reused

briefs.label: Fog that walks with you
briefs.why: Fog that drifts against movement reads as depth and gives a sense of travel without extra sprites.
briefs.keep: a walk-offset uniform added to a time drift in the fog sampling
briefs.change: ours tints the fog by zone and scales the drift with player speed, and uses our own noise texture

briefs.label: Death card with a penalty line
briefs.why: A loss stated in one line, with one clear action, is easier to accept than a chain of dialogs.
briefs.keep: one window that shows the death type and the penalty, then one action
briefs.change: ours shows the loss in plain words, respawns at the nearest shrine, and has no reconnect step

briefs.label: Status glyphs on a health ring
briefs.why: Conditions as small glyphs round a ring keep the portrait clean and show several states at once.
briefs.keep: status glyphs placed round a circular health display
briefs.change: ours uses a segmented stamina ring with threat colour and our own glyph set
